title: Workspace members
intro: Invite people to read what you choose to share. Invitations are never emailed; copy the link and send it yourself.
ownerOnly: Only the workspace owner can manage members.
invite.heading: Create an invitation link
linkHelp: This link is shown once and expires in 7 days. Anyone with it can try to join as the invited email.
copyFailed: Copy failed. Select the link and copy it manually.
removeBody: They lose access to this workspace and everything shared with them.
forbidden: Only the workspace owner can do this.
conflict: The workspace changed. The list was refreshed; try again.
requestFailed: The request could not be completed.
invite.title: Join a workspace
invite.intro: You were invited to read a shared workspace.
invite.missing: This invitation link is missing or has already been opened. Ask the owner for a new link.
invite.signedIn: You are signed in. Accepting joins this workspace with your account.
invite.wrongAccount: This invitation cannot be accepted with the current account.
invite.passwordHelp: Use a real password of at least 12 characters. You will sign in with your email and this password.
invite.googleReady: Google account verified. Accept to finish; no password is needed.
invite.googleFailed: Google enrollment could not be started.
invite.unavailable: This invitation is no longer available. Ask the owner for a new link.
invite.tooMany: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
invite.authRequired: This email already has an account. Sign in with it, then open the link again.
